Subbycat.title: Subbycat, The District Manager of Affection
Subbycat.text:
Subbycat physique might be tiny and dangerously easy to cuddle with, but never mistake her small body for a lack of authority. During the day, she is the district manager of affection, her clipboard in hand, tail swishins behind her as she conducts cuddle inspections making absolutely nobody is left alone on bad days.
She adores holding people, making them blush, taking care of them in every little gentle ways possible and making them feel comfortable until escape  becomes mostly theoretical. Beneath her sweetness lives a much more mischievous history. Once in a while her demoness side comes out, wicked confidence, teasing charm, and the ability to look adorable while obviously plotting something.
Even in her natural form, traces of the demoness still appears when the kitty gets too excited, when her tail flicks, or when someone challenges her cuddle authority. Subbycat's magic has always been very simple: She loves fiercely, comforts and protects instinctively and makes even the worst days feel softer. Just remember the most important rule in her district: If you see a pet, you pet the pet!

Ale.title: Alessandro, the goodest boy
Ale.text:
The ale plushie seems happiest when he knows where he belongs: Close to you, in his pet suit, waiting patiently for his praises. Sweet, loyal, obedient, th plushie takes enormous pride in being a good boy and following his owner's instructions with very serious determination as if he is performing the most important mission in the world. His pet suit is his natural habitat.
When inside his suit, he is cozy, his ears relax, his muscles soften, and he responds with tiny happy wiggles and he becomes content when he is near the person he trusts. He may be obedient, but never without meaning: his loyalty comes from trust, comfort and the joy of making someone he cares happy.

M.title: Plugin Creator.
M.text:
Nobody inside the plushie universe completely understands what M is. Some claim it is the plugin's developer, others insist that it is an ancient entity capable of weaving personalities into fabric, stuffing and questionable amount of coding magic. However, everyone agrees on this: M created the system. Every little plushie carries a tiny fragment of who they represent and that is only because M found a way to stitch memories, friendships, habits and personality into thread.
The plushies shift the blame to M whenever something strange happens but M refuses to confirm whether this is deserved.

Unofficial title: The one who gave plushies free will

Official title: Plugin creator

Izneas.title: Izneas, the Silver Dragon
Izneas.text:
Most dragons' most valueable treasures in their hoard are gold, jewels or things that glitter. However, Izneas is different, her favorite treasures are people. Every moment, friend, shared memory, every little ridiculous moment that becomes important, those are her treasures that she guards fiercely.
 She keeps her treasured people close, not only because she wants to possess them, but because to her, being trusted with someone's heart is a much more valuable treasure than any amount of gold. Izneas never seems to realize that she is part of the treasure too: Her warmth, loyalty, softness and stubborn determination to make sure her loved ones don't feel forgotten make her one of the most treasured things in the entire plushie realm.
The silver dragon may think she is protecting the hoard, but to her loved ones, she is one of its most precious pieces.

Lyra.title: Lyra, the Pink Fox
Lyra.text:
Lyra, the pink fox, is a plushie who doesn't find the need to make a grand entrance to be noticed. She is there, simple, soft pink ears, quiet eyes and her presence makes the whole room feel a little more comfortable. She is sweet in her way> not overly sugary, not constantly needing attention, but always offering small signs that she cares. She always keep a quiet spot saved beside her for her loved ones.
Her pink fox form suits her personality: Warm, clever, affectionate and just a little elusive. She may not be the loudest one but her loyalty speaks for her. In the plushie realm, she has become a symbol of something rare and comforting: the one who stays. Sometimes, simply knowing someone is still here has its own kind of magic.

Subbycat & Luna.title: Subbycat & Luna, the double cuddle
Subbycat & Luna.text: Some plushies cuddle, some sit close. The Subbycat and Luna plushie combo, however, are holding hands. The adorable duo is often found side by side, little paws linked together like they have decided that separation is unnecessary and suspicious. Subbycat brings her usual sweet but mischievous energy, proudly taking Luna's hand like she is holding a very important treasure. Luna, soft and shy in her own moonlit kitty way, uses her kitty mannerism to be unbearably cute.

Subbycat & Ale.title: Subbycat & Ale, The cuddlelock pair
Subbycat & Ale.text:
The Subbycat and Ale plush are another pair that end up tangled together. Subbycat sneaks in behind and wraps herself around him with all the authority of a tiny little kitty who decided that her good boy is not going anywhere. Ale is perfectly happy with the arrangement. She settles into her immediately, softening under her care. Their dynamic is simple but sweet: Subbycat loves spoiling her good boy and her good boy loves being cared for.
Subby brings her playful confidence and ale brings his obedient softness. If found together, do not separate. The good boy is comfortable, and the kity has paperwork.

Subbycat & Terra.title: Subbycat & Terra, The Kitty & Puppy Pair
Subbycat & Terra.text:
Subbycat and Terra are what happens when a mischievous little kitty and the goodest puppy decide personal space is optional. The goodest puppy is almost always wiggling around her mewstress, leaning in, or trying to get a little closer while Subbycat responds by keeping her close. Their plushies are often found sitting together: One usually end up pressed against the other.
Terra loves being praised, spoiled, kept close and Subbycat absolutely loves having a puppy to dote on, tease whenever the wiggles get dramatic. Together, they are playful and affection, just chaotic enough to keep the rest of the plushie realm entertained.

Subbycat & Pink.title: Subbycat & Pink, the trouble pair
Subbycat & Pink.text:
SThis duo looks harmless enough at first: One tiny kitty and one bright pink splash of sweetness sitting side by side like they are not planning anything. Pink brings that little spark with her soft, playful, quietly charming smile. Pink makes the room around her  feel brighter without taking the spotlight, slipping her own sweetness into the room. Subbycat contributes cuddles, dramatic affection laws, tiny kitty confidence and just enough of her mischiefs to encourage Pink's ideas.
Together, they become a dangerously adorable combination of pink and red tinted trouble and chaos. Pink makes mischief look sweeter, Subbycat makes the sweetness more suspicious and both of them always look innocent afterward.

Subbycat and Steele.title: Tiny Bodyguards
Subbycat and Steele.text:
This duo is what happens when one  tiny-cuddled obsessed kitty takes care of someone who looks tough enough to keep chaos under control but melts into a kitty's arms. Subbycat brings her usual mischief: Tail flicks, dramatic affection rules, suspicious innocent smiles and her very own confidence. Steele brings her hard boiled egg energy: Her firm shell  from the outside, while hiding a much softer center undearneath.
Steele has a very mischievous streak of her own but the two become an extremely dangerous combination. Beneath the teasing, there is a lot of genuine softness. Subbycat is good at slipping past Steele's tough exterior. Steele is Subbycat's precious fox and she knows it.

Terra.title: Terra, The goodest puppy
Terra.text:
Terra has earned thoroughly the title of goodest puppy through her loyalty, affection, enthusiastic little wiggles, and an absolutely need to be spoiled shamelessly. She loves to be close to her mewstress, leaning into cuddles, getting praised, and behaving like the happiest puppy in the plushie realm. Underneath that sweetness lives a mischievous little menace with one particularly dangerous habit: Nibbling. Terra is a certified serial nibbler.
Ears, cheeks, shoulder, nothing is completely safe once the puppy gets mischievous. She'll pretend she's innocent afterward, usually wiggling like she has no idea what happened. Her mischiefs never last as she melts back into affection, eager for pets, praise or more cuddles. She might be the goodest puppy, but everyone knows that good does not mean innocent

Steele.title: The Guardian
Steele.text:
Steele is an adorable hard-boiled egg: tough little shell on the outside but unexpectedly soft once you get through her shell. At first, she can come off as guarded until mischief starts. Steele has a naughty streak, a habit of encouraging chaos and increasing a room's lewdness. She likes to tease, get people riled up and act like she didn't do anything suspicious.  Under all of that naughtiness is someone much softer than peope know.
She cares deeply, notices more than she lets on, has a very gentle side reserved for the ones she trusts. Her plushie is equal parts protector and equal parts troublemaker: Firm enough to make you think twice, mischievous enough to make you laugh anywhere and extremely soft inside.

Izzy & Lily.title: Izzy & Lyly, the inseparable duo
Izzy & Lily.text:
Izzy and lyly are the kind of plushies that make more sense together. Put one on the shelf by herself and somehow a few minutes later the other one appears. Their bond is built on trust, little adventures, closeness and the sort of closeness that doesn't need to be explained. Izzy brings her spark of dragon energy and curiosity while lyly balances it with her own mischievous sweetness that keeps the pair glued together.
Together, they turn ordinary moments into something memorable, involving a little mischief. One rule has become universally accepted in the plushie realm: If you find Izzy or Lyly, make room for the other.

Hari.title: The Bright Spark
Hari.text:
Hari is a little blue kitty with the look of someone who has already done something suspicious and is now waiting to see if anyone noticed. Bright, curious, and mischievous, she turns quiet moments into tiny adventures. The plushie loves appearing in places she probably should not have reached, and wearing that innocent expression that convinces absolutely nobody.
Her blue coloring makes her stand out immediately when she is not hidden behind someone but it is her playful personality that keeps everyone's attention. She can bee cheeky, clever, and chaotic enough to keep the plushie realm interesting. Underneath all that trouble, there is plenty of sweetness. Hari may cause mischief but she is also the kind of kitty who likes to stick around and curl up close.
In the plushie realm, she is the proof that blue can be as dangerous as pink when attached to a very mischievous kitty

Fog.title: The Elusive Plush
Fog.text: A placeholder legend for now: mysterious, difficult to photograph, and apparently capable of hiding its proper artwork in the fog.

Hira.title: Hira, soft heart
Hira.text:
Hira may look like an intimidating plushie, with her darker style and unmistakable goth energy. Her look only makes her softness underneath stand out more. Her plushie is the kind that has been through enough to learn how valueable a safe place is, which is why she treasures the cuddle room and the people who make her feel comfortable enough to lower her guard. She doesn't hand out her softness carelessly but when she does it is genuine, warm and deeply felt.
She can be thoughtful, emotional, stubborn and a little dramatic when needed but you can always notice that sweetness hiding beneath the dark fabric. In the plushie realm, she is known as a softie.

Pink.title: Pink, cuteness overload
Pink.text:
Pink the the sweet pink plushie who makes everything around her brighter without doing anything specific. She is sweet, playful, mischievous but her personality is genuine. The pink plushie likes to slip into ordinary moments and turn them memorable. She might not be the loudest plushie in the room but that is onlu because her charm works much more quietly, sneaking on people and making them smile.
She has a soft side too that is shown in little gestures and she always finds a moment for the people she cares for. Her innocent sweetness should never be trusted completely. If she is looking pleased with herself, ther eis a very good chance she is planning a scheme

Kyutie.title: Kyutie, the curious one
Kyutie.text:
Kyutie is the plushie who is found where she is not supposed to or places impossible to reach. If something interesting is happening, Kyu is the first to arrive and ask questions. She is endlessly curious, naturally adorable, and mischievous enough to make everyone wonder if that innocent face can be trusted. She loves discovering new things, inserting herself into what others are doing, and turning small moments into adventures.
She just needs to know what is happening, where everyone is, what everyone is doing, why a plush moved. In the plushie realm, she is proof that curiosity doesn't always kill the kitty, sometimes it leaves her stuck somewhere strange, pleased with herself.
